The Delhi Police Head Constable CBT Exam 2026 was conducted from 7th January to 12th January 2026. Now, the Delhi Police Head Constable Result 2026 has been released on 5th June 2026 on the official website ssc.gov.in. Delhi Police Head Constable Result Out

The Delhi Police Head Constable Result 2026 has been announced on 5th June 2026. The result has been published in PDF format on the official website of the Staff Selection Commission. The result lists the roll number of candidates shortlisted for the next stage i.e., PET. Candidates with consistently higher scores in the online test are likely to increase their chances of selection, depending on category-wise merit and overall competition level.

Delhi Police Head Constable 2026 Result Overview

A total of 587 male and 2342 female candidates have been shortlisted for the PET round. Delhi Police Head Constable has a total of 456 vacancies announced for the recruitment. Candidates can check important details related to the recruitment process.

Delhi Police Head Constable Result Download Link

Candidates can access the Delhi Police Head Constable result PDF on the official website of SSC. Candidates can download the result from the notice board section of the SSC website’s homepage. The PDF consists of the roll numbers of shortlisted candidates for the next stage. A direct download link is provided below for easy access.

Direct Link to Download Delhi Police Head Constable Result 2026

How to Download Delhi Police Head Constable Result 2026?

Candidates who appeared for the exam conducted from 7th to 12th January 2026 can check their Delhi Police Head Constable Result 2026 online through the official portal. Candidates can follow the instructions below to access and download the results.

  1. Visit the official website @ssc.gov.in.
  2. Navigate to the notice board section available on the homepage.
  3. Click on Head Constable (Ministerial) in Delhi Police Examination, 2025 – Declaration of result of Computer Based Examination for shortlisting candidates to appear in Physical Endurance and Measurement Test (PE and MT)/ Document Verification (DV)/ Trade Test (Skill Test).
  4. Click on the PDF and search for your roll number.
  5. Download the result PDF and save it for future reference.

Details Mentioned on Delhi Police Head Constable Result 2026

The Delhi Police Head Constable Result PDF contains important information about the candidate’s performance in the examination. Candidates should carefully verify all the details. In case of discrepancy, the candidate should immediately report to the concerned authorities for correction. The following details are mentioned in the result.

  1. Name of the Recruiting Body
  2. Exam Name
  3. Post Name
  4. Roll Numbers of Shortlisted Candidates
  5. Registration Numbers
  6. Instructions for the next stage
  7. Result declaration date
  8. Cut Off

Delhi Police Head Constable Scorecard 2026

After the announcement of the results, the Delhi Police Head Constable scorecard will be made available on the official website of SSC. Candidates can access their scorecard by using their login credentials, such as Registration Number and Date of Birth. The scorecard will display sectional and total marks. With the help of a scorecard, candidates can understand their performance in the examination.

What’s Next After Delhi Police Head Constable Result 2026?

After the Delhi Police Head Constable Result 2026, the shortlisted candidates will move to the next stage, i.e., PE&MT/ DV/ Trade Test (Skill Test). This stage checks the physical strength and ability of the candidate. It is to be noted that there will be no interview in this recruitment process.
